sample_unit: retrospective case summaries with autopsy-confirmed diagnoses

links.outcome: Top-3 and taxonomy-level diagnostic accuracy of AI versus neurologists on same cases against neuropathology
links.effect: DIAGNO matched or outperformed neurologists in top-3 accuracy (0.67 versus 0.63) and taxonomy-level accuracy (0.74 versus 0.66); more often correct in disagreements (29 versus 19 cases); also outperformed GPT-4o and DeepSeek R1.
links.quote: DIAGNO matched or outperformed neurologists in top-3 accuracy (0.67 versus 0.63) and taxonomy-level accuracy (0.74 versus 0.66).

unlisted_practices: Confidence-aware routing that triggers retrieval-augmented generation only for lower-confidence cases
Neuropathologically confirmed ground truth benchmark for diagnostic AI

screen.reason: Evaluates a new LLM-based diagnostic decision-support system (DIAGNO) and benchmark (NeuroBench) against neuropathological ground truth, comparing model and neurologist performance without formally evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
